name: Tiled stove
summary: A stove of fired clay tiles holds a hot fire for an hour and gives out its heat for a day. Long flues inside the stove take heat from the smoke.
how: Build a firebox and long inner flues of fireclay.
Cover the body with glazed tiles of 20 to 30 cm.
Burn one hot load of wood in 1 to 2 hours and close the damper.
Let the tile mass give out heat for 12 to 24 hours.

origin.note: A Council commission of 1767 leads to a new Swedish stove design with narrow flues and a closed damper.

adoptions.via: Swedish architects and potteries make tiled stoves with a closed damper for city flats and manors.
